fixed_controls: Explicit band frequencies, Q/gain/shape/slope/routing, active/solo, knee, mix, linking and stereo pairs. Per-band dynamics overrides are refused in this initial shared-dynamics fitter.
method: Fixed Matern5/2 GP learned from native training losses, expected improvement over log10 loss, then bounded Nelder-Mead. Classical comparator uses the same initial Sobol design, additional Sobol proposals and the same refinement, under the same proposal allowance.
runtime_boundary: Existing native Dynamic EQ processes every candidate. No learned inference or envelope replacement in audio processing.
data: Two training sources and at least one separately identified validation source; whole-source grouping and sample alignment are declared. Current experiment is synthetic native reconstruction at 48 kHz mono.
admission: Each train/validation clip relative RMS <=0.002 and max absolute error <=0.01; at least 0.001 relative-RMS and 50% improvement over dry; native preset reopening within 1e-7; refuse observed nearby-loss alternatives at normalized control distance >=0.099. Additionally every channel must have error RMS / max(input RMS, reference RMS, 1e-6) <=0.002 and max absolute error <=0.01, preventing aggregate masking of quiet channels.
uncertainty: Observed search history and coordinate sensitivity probes are not global identifiability or calibrated confidence.
surrogate_adoption: Opt-in experiment only. Improves two unknown-control development cases, worsens the harder one; both methods reject the harder case. No general superiority claim.
remaining: Structural/per-band learned proposal coverage and broader classical comparisons
Real paired recordings, held-out levels/transients/rates/layouts/shapes/routes and listening
Calibrated ambiguity/admission policy and actual host/resource/cross-platform validation
synthetic_shift_coverage: Eight additional cases:44.1/48/96/192kHz;1/2/6/8 channels;1/2/8 bands;all shapes/placements. Eight-channel case is a silent-channel corruption negative, not a positive eight-channel quality claim.
